topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the doorbell rang, I thought it was just the echo of a faraway thunder, but there stood a postman with an envelope, its corners slightly curled like the pages of a much-loved book. "Must be a mistake," he said, but there was no mistake in my smile. I took it, imagining the hands that once held it, the same hands that once walked these halls. Opening it, I found a letter, words from another time, a story that began before I moved in. The words swirled around me, like leaves caught in a gentle eddy, each one a whisper of the past. I wondered about the person it was meant for, but mostly, I felt a lovely connection, a bridge between lives, a shared moment in this place we both called home.
